request: 首帧是一只手放在关闭的雨伞柄上，让它打开雨伞，固定镜头无配乐。

shots.description: A static close shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the hand, sleeve, closed umbrella and existing framing. The hand tightens around the handle and pushes the runner upward; the ribs spread continuously until the canopy is fully open. The hand settles into a steady grip as the fabric stops moving.

document.overall_soundscape: A brief mechanical click accompanies the runner moving upward, followed by a soft snap and rustle of the opening canopy.
